identity.label: MUX-NOVA (Bonsai Dojo)
identity.description: Auxiliary Ollama host on the nim-substation-bonsai workstation, reachable over Tailscale. Owned hardware sitting idle most of the day - the low-cost dispatch target. A rogue syndicate: the model emits tool calls and the agency harness executes them (read-only filesystem functions, confined to the mission working directory). No shell, no writes.

channels.label: Qwen3 Coder 30B
channels.notes: 30.5B MoE, Q4_K_M. Measured ~64 tok/s eval warm; first call after idle pays a model-load penalty of roughly 10s. max_concurrent is 1 deliberately - one workstation GPU is not a fleet, and parallel requests queue behind each other anyway. Context: 32768 tokens served (context_length from /api/ps, verified 2026-10-14). The model advertises 262144, but 18 GB of weights plus a 256k q8_0 KV cache exceeds 32 GB of unified memory; ~131072 is the hardware ceiling.
